source_snapshot.test_name_items: Event Logs View Smbios Event Log
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

The agent cannot press keys in the pre-OS BIOS setup UI or observe the saved/reloaded screen over SSH; a person must navigate Setup and reboot.

original_test_intent: The item indicates a read-only check that BIOS can display the SMBIOS Event Log and its expected records, but Procedure and Criteria instead require arbitrary setting changes, persistence and default restoration. These are different test objectives and evidence models.
original_method: Enter the firmware page, but then perform a generic change/save/reboot/default sequence even though no setting is identified. The source contains no event stimulus, expected record content, pagination/view requirement or log-store mapping.
manual_activity: After scope correction, a human must navigate the pre-OS log viewer and visually confirm record content, ordering and access behavior. No setting change, save/default cycle or log erasure is authorized under the current row.
required_inputs: Owner decision selecting read-only view or a separately specified settings test
Corrected procedure and criteria for the selected scope
BIOS SMBIOS log ownership and relationship to BMC SEL/OS logs
Controlled benign event and expected record type/time/severity/source if view-only
Console/evidence capture and immutable log archive
safety_requirements: Do not execute arbitrary setting changes or Load Default to satisfy a View item.
Do not clear, filter or alter any log while the scope is unresolved.
Archive available log stores before any later approved mutation and preserve time/source attribution.
Never accept BMC SEL or OS output as proof of the BIOS viewer without an explicit mapping.
Stop on unexpected evidence loss or management failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BIOS/BMC/OS identity and log baselines where non-destructive access exists.
After correction, correlate expected records with operator screenshots and flag missing or mismatched fields.
Do not drive BIOS, mutate/clear logs, invent a setting or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve the source scope and align Item, Procedure and Criteria.
If view-only, perform the controlled event and inspect/capture the firmware log viewer; if settings, define a separate bounded field lifecycle.
Evaluate scope-matched evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The manual boundary is correct, but its proposed generic setting behavior is inapplicable to a View function. No source command exists.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not add a mutation command. Preserve read-only log export/inventory only after establishing that it addresses the same SMBIOS log store; firmware screenshots remain required for UI viewing coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The null script and 5/20-minute fields are recorded. The change/save/default steps are preserved as conflicting source facts and are not executable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For view-only scope, generate or select a benign known event, archive all stores, open the BIOS SMBIOS viewer and verify record source, type/severity, timestamp/order, pagination and persistence without mutation. Define a separate case if configuration behavior is intended.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Undetermined until the owner confirms the BIOS SMBIOS log implementation and intended scope.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, event generator and any read-only export-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS Event Log viewer and event-format documentation is required.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces an unrelated setting/default template with scope-matched read-only view behavior.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores the named viewing coverage; it does not claim configuration persistence unless that becomes a separately corrected objective.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Scope decision, expected record model and store mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: External log exports do not prove firmware UI rendering, navigation or pagination.

project_override_considerations: A project can choose a view-only event subset, but cannot use a generic setting override to claim the View requirement. Any settings test must be explicitly separated and reported as different coverage.
expected_evidence: Owner decision and corrected source scope
If view-only: controlled event provenance and BIOS viewer captures of expected fields/order
If settings: separately defined field/value/persistence/default evidence
Final log/configuration health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require viewing the SMBIOS Event Log, while Procedure and Criteria require changing an unspecified value, proving persistence and restoring defaults. A read-only viewer has no identified setting to satisfy those steps.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core test objective and acceptance are contradictory. Choosing view behavior or configuration behavior would materially change execution and coverage, so an owner decision is required before safe work.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its generic setting interpretation while retaining the pre-OS human boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with BLOCKED and strengthens store identity, viewer-specific fields and evidence-preservation requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps view coverage distinct from settings/default coverage and records an explicit case-specific engineering decision.

review_improvement: Prevents alteration or erasure of diagnostic evidence under a row whose name calls only for viewing and defines the evidence a corrected viewer test would need.
independent_technical_reasoning: There is no safe way to infer which of two materially different intents governs. The current mutation steps cannot prove viewer behavior and could destroy the evidence under inspection; this is a genuine SOURCE_CONFLICT and BLOCKED condition.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat event generation, viewing, setting changes, reboots or log operations automatically; preserve the first evidence and require engineer disposition.
